 Search Home New Top Charts Sign In April 8, 2022 MI Rewind: Warren Buffett, Charlie Munger, and Berkshire Hathaway w/ Adam Mead The Intrinsic Value Podcast - The Investor’s Podcast Network 1h 9m IN THIS EPISODE YOU’LL LEARN: 

 
 03:18 - Who is Warren Buffett and Charlie Munger? 
 03:18 - How did they influence each other’s investing approach? 
 06:36 - Who is Benjamin Graham and what was his impact on Buffett? 
 08:46 - What is value investing and why is it relevant in today’s market? 
 25:12 - The evolution of Berkshire Hathaway (BRK) and common misconceptions about it. 
 37:20 - Why Buffett hasn’t deployed BRK’s large cash pile amid the COVID crisis. 
 43:51 - Why investors shouldn’t just copy Buffett’s stock picks. 
 45:20 - What has been the leading cause for Buffett’s underperformance over the last decade? 
 52:22 - The timeless principles of the Oracle of Omaha that have led to his success and are worth following. 
 57:08 - The future of BRK and if it will survive without Buffett and/or Munger. 
 And much, much more! 
 *Disclaimer: Slight timestamp discrepancies may occur due to podcast platform differences. 

 BOOKS AND RESOURCES 

 
 Join the exclusive TIP Mastermind Community to engage in meaningful stock investing discussions with Kyle and the other community members. 
 Robert and Clay’s tool for picking stock winners and managing our portfolios: TIP Finance . 
 Adam Mead’s book The Complete Financial History of Berkshire Hathaway . 
 
 Mead Capital Management website . 
 The Oracle’s Classroom YouTube Channel.  
 Stig Brodersen and Preston Pysh’s book Warren Buffett Accounting Book .
 
 SPONSORS 

 Support our free podcast by supporting our  sponsors :

 
 ⁠Fiscal.AI⁠ 
 Connect with Adam Mead: Website  | Twitter | LinkedIn | Facebook  

 Connect with Robert: Instagram  |  Twitter  |  LinkedIn  | Facebook
